segments_b.text: Hi, Dad! We were making mush at the Ashera cooking labs.
Loner and Negan called a meeting in the library.
Now don't be rude. I know you're excited. Say hello to our guests.
Welcome, everyone! Come with us! Hurry! We'll be late!
Well, I guess you're coming with us. Let's go!
